senses.label: Sound
examples: Birdsong every morning — no traffic until 8am
Bass from the pub shakes the walls on Fridays

senses.label: Smell
examples: Pine air in the evenings — first time I breathed deeply
Weed smoke drifts through the walls after 9pm

senses.label: Light
examples: Proper darkness at night — stars visible, finally slept
Street light opposite the bedroom, inescapable

senses.label: Atmosphere
examples: A calm I have never felt anywhere before
Social tension in the air — people seem stressed

senses.label: Nature
examples: Fox family living under the garden shed
No green space within walking distance

senses.label: External Heat
examples: Heat radiates off the walls in waves
The sun bakes this street all afternoon

senses.label: External Cold
examples: A crisp chill sits over this place
Cold air pools here, sharp and clear

senses.label: Vibration
examples: A subtle hum you can feel in the ground
The whole place seems to softly buzz

senses.label: Anomaly
examples: Three lights in formation — not aircraft. Others saw it.
An overwhelming feeling of being watched here

senses.label: Safety
examples: Feel completely safe walking here at any hour
Cars speed through this residential street dangerously

senses.label: Belonging
examples: Neighbour left homegrown tomatoes on my doorstep
Felt invisible here — no acknowledgement

senses.label: Intuition
examples: A strong feeling I should not linger here
Something tells me this place is kind

senses.label: Chronosception (Time)
examples: Time moves slowly here — unhurried, gentle
The hours seem to vanish in this place

senses.label: Stress
examples: The air feels tense and on edge
A pressure here I can't quite name

senses.label: Hunger
examples: A hollow, wanting feeling in this place
Something here leaves me craving more

senses.label: Hydration
examples: The air is fresh and quenching here
A dry, thirsting quality to this place

senses.label: Internal Temp
examples: A deep inner warmth settles in here
This place warms me from within

senses.label: Pain
examples: A sharp, aching quality to this place
Something here registers as hurt

senses.label: Proprioception
examples: I feel grounded and balanced here
An easy sense of where my body sits

senses.label: Taste
examples: Salt on the air near the harbour
The bakery’s cinnamon reaches the street

senses.label: Touch
examples: Warm stone under my hand on the old wall
Cool railings, smooth from years of hands

senses.label: External Heat
examples: Sun-baked pavement radiating up
Heat pouring from the bakery door

senses.label: External Cold
examples: A cold draught curls around this corner
Frost-air off the river at dawn

senses.label: Inner Temperature
examples: I always warm from within here
A feverish flush passed through me at this spot

senses.label: Premonition
examples: I felt this moment coming before it arrived
A knowing settled here just before the news

senses.label: Déjà Vu
examples: I’ve lived this exact moment here before
This corner repeats itself in me

senses.label: Clairvoyance
examples: An image arrived here that wasn’t mine to see — yet true
This place shows me things before my eyes do

senses.label: Clairaudience
examples: I heard my name here when no one spoke
A voice on the air, clear and kind, at this bench

senses.label: Anxiety
examples: A tightness rises in me whenever I pass this spot
My chest hums with worry on this street

senses.label: Social Anxiety
examples: Crowds press close here and I fold inward
Eyes on me at this corner — real or imagined

senses.label: Emotional Overwhelm
examples: Everything arrives at once in this place
Too many currents meeting — I lose my own

senses.label: Loneliness
examples: Surrounded here, and somehow far from everyone
This bench knows my quietest hours

senses.label: Dream
examples: I dreamed of this exact place before I found it
A dream keeps returning me here

senses.label: Prediction Dream
examples: What I dreamt here later came to pass
The dream arrived first — the moment followed

senses.label: Clairsentience
examples: I feel what this room has been holding
The emotion of this place enters me whole

senses.label: Claircognizance
examples: I simply knew, here, without knowing how
An undeniable certainty arrived at this spot

senses.label: Synchronicity
examples: The same symbol reached me twice today, from strangers
This place answered a thought I hadn’t spoken

senses.label: Joy
examples: Something lifted in me the moment I turned this corner
I laughed out loud here and could not have said why

senses.label: Love
examples: This is where we met, and the air still knows it
I think of someone every time I pass this bench

senses.label: Wonder
examples: I stood still far longer than I meant to
The sky opened over this field and I forgot myself

senses.label: Gratitude
examples: A quiet thank-you rises in me at this spot
Someone was kind to me here and I never forgot it

senses.label: Hope
examples: Something might yet come right — I felt it here
First green on this verge after a long winter

senses.label: Peace
examples: Nothing in me is arguing while I stand here
The noise drops away at this bend in the path

senses.label: Rest
examples: My shoulders come down when I reach this place
I sleep well on this side of town

senses.label: Relief
examples: A held breath let go as I came through the gate
The worry loosened its grip somewhere along here

senses.label: Numbness
examples: I feel very little here, and I notice that I do not
The world goes flat and quiet around this junction

senses.label: Weariness
examples: This hill is heavier every time I climb it
I arrive here already spent, most days

senses.label: Heaviness
examples: Something presses down on me along this stretch
The air sits close and low around this building

senses.label: Memory
examples: The summer we spent here as kids
Where we said goodbye, and meant it

intro: A living alphabet… Try sensing the living meaning of the Alphasense symbols — observe the unique shapes and the glowing aura light within each. Symbols can stand alone, for sharing sentiment, compassion and bonding. They can also fuse together, physically, into Alphabonds — and where they do, a new third meaning is born, inspired by both. This new meaning widens our sense of time, connection, place and energy, opening new gateways of perception.
